blocks.en: # Complex systems and troubleshooting **English** · [简体中文](TROUBLESHOOTING.zh-CN.md) [Repository home](../README.md#contents) ## First-error index | Error or symptom | Likely cause | First action | | --- | --- | --- | | `has no donors AND has no acceptors` with a valid ligand group | Element fields omitted in the ligand topology | [Check encoded atomic numbers](#atomic-number-analysis) | | `ValueError: interrupted residues in PDB: {'A:438'}` | Pinned public example contains an out-of-order PDB record | Use the fixture-specific coordinate-preserving ordering step | | `Explicit valence for atom # 16 N, 4, is greater than permitted` | Teaching MOL2–RDKit representation disagreed on valence | Recover the SDF via Open Babel and verify the chemical graph and +1 charge | | Low ranked region RMSD, high top-1 RMSD | Near-native pose sampled but ranked lower | Report top-1 and best-sampled results independently | | High fixed-frame RMSD for all ranks | Wrong box/frame, pose sampling, or incorrect atom correspondence | Check box, receptor frame, and symmetric graph mapping | | High apparent MD ligand RMSD with unchanged contacts | Potential PBC image or coordinate ordering error | Reimage, fit the protein and verify topology order | | Matching atom count with wrong atom order | Coordinate concatenation or reordering error | Check names and coordinate correspondence against the topology | | SETTLE or LINCS error early | Potential severe overlap or constraint/starting-model problem | Inspect structure, minimization and preflight parameters | [Main tutorial](../README.md#contents) · [References and software citation](REFERENCES.md#references) This page uses generic systems and filenames. Identify the first failing stage and retain its inputs, log, and software versions. Error strings are search terms. Their wording can vary by release and backend. ## Contents 1. [Triage](#triage) 2. [Complex receptors and membrane systems](#complex-systems) 3. [Docking, template matching, and pose recovery](#docking-errors) 4. [Parameterization and topology](#topology-errors) 5. [Minimization, equilibration, and trajectories](#simulation-errors) 6. [Portability, GPU execution, and restart](#server-errors) 7. [Tutorial pitfalls](#tutorial-error-flow) · [Workflow comparison](#chem3d-pymol-topology) ## 1. Triage | Symptom or message | Start here | | --- | --- | | No matching residue template | [Check structure and chemistry](#complex-systems) | | Missing poses or failed SDF export | [Check inputs, MODEL, and mapping](#docking-errors) | | Directive order, missing parameters, or mismatched coordinates | [Inspect includes, parameters, and molecule order](#topology-errors) | | Constraint failure or nonfinite forces or energies | [Locate the first failure and its inputs](#simulation-errors) | | TPR compatibility, GPU memory, or checkpoint append failure | [Check versions, hardware, and companion files](#server-errors) | Record the last completed step and its outputs. Resume from the last validated coordinates and checkpoint where appropriate. Changes to chemical identity, atom order, or topology require revalidation from the first affected stage. [GROMACS runtime errors](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/user-guide/run-time-errors.html) · [GROMACS restart and extension](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/user-guide/managing-simulations.html) ## 2. Complex receptors and membrane systems | System feature | Minimum modeling checks | | --- | --- | | Multichain assembly, partner, or interface pocket | Verify the biological assembly, interface, occupancy, and interchain covalent links. Retain chains that form the pocket or stabilize its conformation. | | Missing loops, alternate conformers, multiple models, or predicted structures | Use sequence and structural evidence to assess the pocket impact of missing segments. Record the selected chains, models, and edits. Examine local pLDDT and interdomain PAE where relevant. Compare justified receptor conformations and report recurrence of pockets and poses. | | Nonstandard residues, modifications, metals, or cofactors | Check identity, protonation, oxidation or coordination state, covalent links, and total charge against the structural and experimental evidence. Validate atom types, masses, partial charges, bonded terms, and coordinate mapping for the chosen force field. | | Membrane proteins and membrane assemblies | Verify assembly and membrane orientation, build a compatible explicit bilayer, and resolve lipid–protein overlaps. Check leaflet assignment and box orientation before minimization and staged equilibration. Verify semi-isotropic pressure coupling against the chosen membrane protocol. | | Glycosylation or topology conversion | Preserve glycoform, anomeric configuration, and covalent connectivity. Verify 1–4 scaling, exclusions, atom ordering, masses, and charges. Compare energy terms for a representative subsystem using identical geometry and matched settings. | | Covalent ligands or reactive sites | Use a dedicated modeling and docking protocol appropriate to the chemical state, with evidence for the covalent connection and reactive site. | **When to pause.** Pause when essential pocket geometry, domain arrangement, chemical state, or topology conversion remains unresolved. Check compatibility across protein, lipid, glycans, water, ions, and ligand parameters. Explicit pair definitions can preserve validated heterogeneous 1–4 scaling. Changes to global `fudgeQQ` or `fudgeLJ` affect all pairs generated from defaults.[1](#ref-1),[2](#ref-2),[3](#ref-3) [AlphaFold DB confidence and PAE](https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/faq) · [Amber reference manuals](https://ambermd.org/Manuals.php) · [GROMACS topology file formats](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/reference-manual/topologies/topology-file-formats.html) · [Lipid21 paper](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jctc.1c01217) · [GLYCAM06 paper](https://doi.org/10.1002/jcc.20820) · [PACKMOL-Memgen paper](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jcim.9b00269) **Equilibration checks for membrane systems.** Inspect temperature, volume, lateral bilayer area, thickness, leaflet behavior, and essential covalent links. Review geometry and periodic imaging when membrane folds or image jumps appear. Interpret area, thickness, and area per lipid against composition, temperature, and metric definition. Verify which position restraints are active before interpreting subsequent relaxation. [GROMACS MDP parameters](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/user-guide/mdp-options.html) · [Lipid21 methods](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jctc.1c01217) ## 3. Docking, template matching, and pose recovery - **Receptor template mismatch.** Inspect the reported residue and neighboring atoms for missing heavy atoms, naming, chain, alternate conformer, termini, and hydrogen state. Determine whether cofactors or special chemistry require a dedicated preparation route.[4](#ref-4) [Meeko receptor preparation](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/rec_cli_options.html) · [GROMACS pdb2gmx](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/onlinehelp/gmx-pdb2gmx.html) - **Ligand preparation failed.** Check the source record, bond orders, stereochemistry, formal charge, and salt form. Generate a 3D conformer for the verified microstate when starting from 2D, and verify explicit hydrogens before invoking Meeko. [Meeko ligand input requirements](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/lig_prep_basic.html) · [Molscrub CLI](https://molscrub.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cli.html) - **Empty output or pose recovery failure.** Inspect the exit status, first error, and output directory. Match the run manifest, PDBQT `MODEL`, score, and SDF record. If mapping metadata is absent, recover with a verified original SDF template or prepare a new input and redock. Verify heavy-atom coordinates against the selected PDBQT `MODEL`. [Meeko export](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/export_usage.html) · [Pose transfer](DOCKING.md#pose-handoff) - **Reference-like pose sampled but poorly ranked.** Report top-ranked RMSD, best sampled RMSD, rank of the best-matching pose, and reference contacts. Verify the search box and chemical state, then compare seeds, conformers, and relevant receptor models. Document any ranking discrepancy.[5](#ref-5),[6](#ref-6) [Vina tutorial](https://autodock-vina.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docking_basic.html) · [DockRMSD](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13321-019-0362-7) · [Docking validation review](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10822-026-00849-8) ## 4. Parameterization and topology | Symptom | Diagnosis and action | | --- | --- | | Charge mismatch, high CGenFF penalty, or incompatible stream | Verify chemistry and coordinates against the docked microstate. Check force-field family and version. Review high-penalty terms and validate any refinement. | | `Invalid order for directive atomtypes` / Global parameter declaration out of order | Inspect include order. Declare global `[ atomtypes ]` before any `[ moleculetype ]`. The selected force field supplies the top-level `[ defaults ]`. | | `No default ... types` / Missing bonded parameter | Trace the reported atoms and interaction term. Check atom types, connectivity, parameter version, and includes. Reprocess after resolving the missing term with a justified parameter assignment. | | Coordinate and topology atom counts differ | Compare the GRO atom count with `[ molecules ]` counts, atoms per molecule, and coordinate order. For a fresh solvation, use the unsolvated complex and its matching topology. | | Ligand displaced or position restraints out of range | Check Å/nm conversion, atom mapping, periodic imaging, and atom order. Position-restraint indices are local to their `[ moleculetype ]`. Use a reference structure with matching atom order. | Rerun `grompp` for the failed stage with separate output paths. Save the preprocessed topology with `-pp` and the processed MDP with `-po`. After successful preprocessing, use these outputs to verify restraints, molecule counts, and production settings.[7](#ref-7) [GROMACS grompp](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/onlinehelp/gmx-grompp.html) · [Topology file formats](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/reference-manual/topologies/topology-file-formats.html) · [CGenFF documentation](https://docs.silcsbio.com/2026/cgenff/usage.html) ## 5. Minimization, equilibration, and trajectories **LINCS, SETTLE, or nonfinite values.** Locate the first failing step and affected atoms. Review minimization forces, steric overlaps, atom order, topology, and restraint references. A warning before the first output frame can require inspection of the previous stage's endpoint. Reprocess and revalidate from consistent inputs after correcting the cause. [GROMACS common errors](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/user-guide/run-time-errors.html) · [Constraint algorithms](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/reference-manual/algorithms/constraint-algorithms.html) **Environment:** `Bash`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh: # 复杂体系与常见报错 [English](TROUBLESHOOTING.md) · **简体中文** [仓库首页](../README.zh-CN.md#contents) ## 首条报错索引 | 报错或现象 | 可能原因 | 优先处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 分组已选到配体，但报 `has no donors AND has no acceptors` | 配体 topology（拓扑）缺元素字段 | [核对原子序数](#atomic-number-analysis) | | `ValueError: interrupted residues in PDB: {'A:438'}` | 固定公开示例有一条乱序 PDB 记录 | 用示例专用的坐标不变排序步骤 | | `Explicit valence for atom # 16 N, 4, is greater than permitted` | 示例 MOL2 与 RDKit 的价态表示不一致 | 通过 Open Babel 转回 SDF，验证化学图与 +1 电荷 | | 有低 RMSD 的低排名结果而首名 RMSD 高 | 采到了近天然 docking pose（对接位姿），但评分排名靠后 | 单列首名与最佳采样结果 | | 所有 docking pose（对接位姿）固定坐标系 RMSD 高 | 盒、参考坐标、采样或原子映射问题 | 复查盒、receptor（受体）坐标系和对称图映射 | | MD 配体 RMSD 高而接触不变 | 可能是 PBC 映像或坐标顺序不匹配 | 重建映像、按蛋白拟合并检查 topology（拓扑）顺序 | | 原子数相同但顺序不同 | 坐标拼接或排序错误 | 按 topology（拓扑）核对原子名和坐标对应 | | 早期 SETTLE 或 LINCS 报错 | 可能有严重冲突或约束、初始模型问题 | 核查结构、最小化和短试跑参数 | [主教程目录](../README.zh-CN.md#contents) · [参考文献与软件引用](REFERENCES.zh-CN.md#references) 本页使用通用体系和文件名。先定位第一个异常阶段，保留原始日志、输入文件和软件版本。表中的故障标记是搜索关键词，实际措辞随软件版本和后端而异。 ## 目录 1. [快速定位](#triage) 2. [复杂 receptor（受体）与膜体系](#complex-systems) 3. [对接、模板匹配与 docking pose（对接位姿）恢复](#docking-errors) 4. [参数化与 topology（拓扑）](#topology-errors) 5. [能量最小化、平衡与轨迹](#simulation-errors) 6. [服务器读取、GPU 与续跑](#server-errors) 7. [网课错误流程图](#tutorial-error-flow) · [Chem3D–ADT–PyMOL 对照](#chem3d-pymol-topology) ## 1. 快速定位 | 症状或消息 | 从这里开始 | | --- | --- | | Meeko 无匹配模板、`Residue ... not found`、非标准残基 | [核查结构和化学模型](#complex-systems) | | 对接无输出、输出缺少 docking pose（对接位姿）、SDF 无法导出 | [核对任务清单、MODEL 和映射](#docking-errors) | | `Invalid order for directive atomtypes`、`No default ... types`、坐标和 topology（拓扑）原子数不同 | [核查 include、参数和分子顺序](#topology-errors) | | `LINCS WARNING`、`water molecules can not be settled`、非有限力或能量 | [定位首次异常和上游输入](#simulation-errors) | | `reading tpx file ... version ...`、CUDA 内存不足、checkpoint 无法追加 | [检查版本、设备和配套文件](#server-errors) | 操作前记录上一阶段实际完成的步数与输出。已完成的环节可从最后一个经核验的坐标和检查点继续。修改化学状态、原子顺序或 topology（拓扑）后，从受影响的第一阶段重新验收。 [GROMACS runtime errors](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/user-guide/run-time-errors.html) · [GROMACS restart and extension](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/user-guide/managing-simulations.html) ## 2. 复杂 receptor（受体）与膜体系 | 体系特征 | 最低建模核查 | | --- | --- | | 多链复合物、共晶伙伴或界面口袋 | 核实生物学组装、链间界面、占有率和链间共价连接。保留构成口袋或稳定构象的必要链。 | | 缺失环、替代构象、多模型或预测结构 | 按序列、结构域和参考结构判断缺失部分是否影响口袋。记录保留链、模型和变更。预测结构在结合区域看 pLDDT，跨域口袋另核查 PAE。比较有依据的多个 receptor（受体）构象并报告口袋与 docking pose（对接位姿）的复现情况。 | | 非标准残基、翻译后修饰、金属或辅因子 | 对照源结构和实验背景确认化学身份、质子化、氧化态或配位、连接方式和总电荷。使用与所选 force field（力场）和状态相容的参数，核查原子类型、质量、partial charge（部分电荷）、键合项及坐标映射。 | | 膜蛋白与膜蛋白复合物 | 核实装配和膜朝向，按所用脂质 force field（力场）构建匹配的显式膜，处理脂质–蛋白重叠。检查膜叶和盒方向后再最小化与分阶段平衡。按所选膜模型核对半各向同性压力耦合。 | | 糖基化或跨软件 topology（拓扑）转换 | 保留正确糖型、异头构型与共价连接。核对 1–4 缩放、排除项、原子序、质量、电荷。对代表性子体系使用相同几何并对齐两端能量设置，比较各能量项。 | | 共价配体或反应中心 | 先为目标化学状态选择专门的建模和对接方案，核查连接及反应位点的证据。 | **什么时候暂停** 口袋关键部分缺失、结构域相对构象无法判断、必要成分的化学状态未定，或 force field（力场）转换无法验证时，先完成结构或参数审查。对于混合成分，逐项核实蛋白、脂质、糖、水、离子和配体参数间的兼容性。需要不同的 1–4 缩放时，可经验证地使用显式配对参数。仅改全局 `fudgeQQ` 或 `fudgeLJ` 会影响所有由默认规则生成的配对。[1](#ref-1),[2](#ref-2),[3](#ref-3) [AlphaFold DB confidence and PAE](https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/faq) · [Amber reference manuals](https://ambermd.org/Manuals.php) · [GROMACS topology file formats](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/reference-manual/topologies/topology-file-formats.html) · [Lipid21 paper](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jctc.1c01217) · [GLYCAM06 paper](https://doi.org/10.1002/jcc.20820) · [PACKMOL-Memgen paper](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jcim.9b00269) **膜体系的平衡验收** 检查温度、体积、侧向膜面积、膜厚、各膜叶行为以及关键共价连接。对膜褶皱或跨膜周期映像，检查几何与成像方式。面积、厚度和每脂质面积按组成、温度与计算定义分别解释。先确认是否还有有效位置限制，再判断放开限制后的行为。 [GROMACS MDP parameters](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/user-guide/mdp-options.html) · [Lipid21 methods](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jctc.1c01217) ## 3. 对接、模板匹配与 docking pose（对接位姿）恢复 - **receptor（受体）模板匹配失败** 核对报错前后的残基、原子名、缺失 heavy atom（重原子）、链、altloc、端基和氢状态，先查明必要的配位、辅因子与非标准基团，再返回制备。[4](#ref-4) [Meeko receptor preparation](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/rec_cli_options.html) · [GROMACS pdb2gmx](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/onlinehelp/gmx-pdb2gmx.html) - **配体制备失败** 按来源核对原始 SDF 的记录号、bond order（键级）、stereochemistry（立体化学）、净电荷和盐形式。2D SDF 先按确认的微观状态生成 3D，Meeko 前确认显式氢。 [Meeko ligand input requirements](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/lig_prep_basic.html) · [Molscrub CLI](https://molscrub.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cli.html) - **输出为空或恢复错误** 先看退出码、第一条错误与输出目录，再对照任务清单、PDBQT `MODEL`、评分和 SDF 记录。映射丢失时用已验证原始 SDF 模板恢复，或重新制备并对接。原位 heavy atom（重原子）坐标须与选中的 PDBQT `MODEL` 对应。 [Meeko export](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/export_usage.html) · [docking pose（对接位姿）交接](DOCKING.zh-CN.md#pose-handoff) - **重对接采样到参考 docking pose（对接位姿）但排名偏低** 同时报第一名 RMSD、候选中最佳 RMSD、该姿态的排名与关键接触。核查搜索盒和状态，并跨种子、构象及适用的 receptor（受体）模型复核。把排名偏差保留在记录里。[5](#ref-5),[6](#ref-6) [Vina tutorial](https://autodock-vina.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docking_basic.html) · [DockRMSD](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13321-019-0362-7) · [Docking validation review](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10822-026-00849-8) ## 4. 参数化与 topology（拓扑） | 症状 | 检查与处理 | | --- | --- | | 配体净电荷不符、CGenFF 罚分过高或 stream 版本不匹配 | 核对用于对接的同一化学状态、手性、净电荷和坐标，确认参数家族和版本。审核高罚分参数，按 force field（力场）方法修正并重新验证。 | | `Invalid order for directive atomtypes` / Global parameter declaration out of order | 检查 include 顺序。全局 `[ atomtypes ]` 在任何 `[ moleculetype ]` 之前声明。顶层 `[ defaults ]` 由所选 force field（力场）控制。 | | `No default ... types` / Missing bonded parameter | 找到报错的原子索引和交互项，核对原子类型、键合 topology（拓扑）、参数版本及 include。补全有方法依据的参数后重新预处理。 | | 坐标和 topology（拓扑）原子数不同 | 对照 GRO 第二行、`[ molecules ]`、每种分子的原子数及实际坐标顺序。重新溶剂化时从未加水的复合物及配套 topology（拓扑）开始。 | | 加水/离子后配体偏离口袋，或限制原子越界 | 对照 Å 与 nm、atom mapping（原子映射）、复合物成像和原子顺序。位置限制编号在所属 `[ moleculetype ]` 内计数，参考文件与目标构象的原子顺序应一致。 | 在独立输出目录重新执行失败阶段的 `grompp`。用 `-pp` 保存展开 topology（拓扑），用 `-po` 保存实际处理的 MDP。预处理成功后，以这一轮生成的文件核对位置限制、分子数量和生产设置。[7](#ref-7) [GROMACS grompp](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/onlinehelp/gmx-grompp.html) · [Topology file formats](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/reference-manual/topologies/topology-file-formats.html) · [CGenFF documentation](https://docs.silcsbio.com/2026/cgenff/usage.html) ## 5. 能量最小化、平衡与轨迹 **LINCS、SETTLE 或非有限值** 先定位异常起始的步数和相关原子，回看最小化最大力、局部重叠、原子顺序、topology（拓扑）与参考位置限制。有些警告在失败阶段的第一帧前出现，需检查上一阶段末态。修复原因后，从一致的输入重新预处理与验收。 [GROMACS common errors](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/user-guide/run-time-errors.html) · [Constraint algorithms](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/reference-manual/algorithms/constraint-algorithms.html) **环境：** `Bash`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

```bash
# Set LOG to the actual log for the failing stage.
LOG='npt.log'
grep -inE 'warning|lincs|settle|fatal error|non-finite|not finite|nan|maximum force' "$LOG"
```

blocks.en: **Equilibration drift or abrupt ligand RMSD changes.** Compare blockwise trends in temperature, density, volume, and pressure. Check periodic imaging and timestamps, then compare whole-protein and local pocket alignment together with contact persistence and minimum distance. Local metrics can help distinguish flexible-domain motion from a change in the ligand pose. Base any extension on recorded evidence.[8](#ref-8) [gmx trjconv](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/onlinehelp/gmx-trjconv.html) · [MD reproducibility checklist](https://doi.org/10.1038/s42003-023-04653-0) ## 6. Portability, GPU execution, and restart - **TPR unreadable on the target.** Compare GROMACS versions and checksums. Test the file on the target with `gmx dump -s md.tpr`. Use a compatible build or regenerate the TPR from archived MDP, topology, coordinates, index, and a compatible checkpoint, then verify the run settings. Retain the original and regenerated files. [gmx dump](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/onlinehelp/gmx-dump.html) · [gmx grompp](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/onlinehelp/gmx-grompp.html) - **CUDA startup failure or insufficient device memory.** Check scheduler allocation, executable build, driver, and log. Isolate the issue with a small single-device job. Reduce the docking batch size where appropriate. Verify GROMACS parallelism and offload options for the installed build. [GROMACS performance](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/user-guide/mdrun-performance.html) · [Uni-Dock](https://github.com/dptech-corp/Uni-Dock) - **Checkpoint append failed.** Check the run prefix, TPR/checkpoint correspondence, and the integrity of the existing outputs. Restore the matching files or restart in separate parts according to the documented procedure, and archive the parts. [Managing long simulations](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/user-guide/managing-simulations.html) - **Ambiguous production status.** Record input readiness, production execution, and completion separately. A readable `md.tpr` supports checking compiled settings. Establish elapsed production from logs, checkpoints, and actual trajectory frames. [Production handoff](SIMULATION.md#server-handoff) [Back to troubleshooting](#troubleshooting-contents) ## Tutorial pitfalls and workflow comparison The examples below show common workflow errors and the checks that detect them. ### Tutorial error flowchart Follow the common failure sequence in the diagram. The table explains the consequences and corrective checks. For docking scores and RMSD, consult the [analysis section](ANALYSIS.md#analysis).
blocks.zh: **平衡漂移或配体 RMSD 突跳** 对比温度、密度、体积及压力的分块趋势。先确认周期性边界成像和帧时间，再比较全蛋白拟合与局部口袋拟合，并检查接触保留和最近距离。局部结果可帮助定位柔性域运动或实际 docking pose（对接位姿）改变。依据实际记录评估是否需要延长。[8](#ref-8) [gmx trjconv](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/onlinehelp/gmx-trjconv.html) · [MD reproducibility checklist](https://doi.org/10.1038/s42003-023-04653-0) ## 6. 服务器读取、GPU 与续跑 - **TPR 在目标机读取失败** 先比对 GROMACS 版本并核对文件校验值。用目标机 `gmx dump -s md.tpr` 只读测试。格式不兼容时优先使用兼容版本，或用归档 MDP、topology（拓扑）、坐标、索引及兼容 checkpoint 重新生成并核对运行设置。归档原 TPR 和重建版本。 [gmx dump](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/onlinehelp/gmx-dump.html) · [gmx grompp](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/onlinehelp/gmx-grompp.html) - **CUDA 启动失败或显存不足** 对照资源分配、实际程序构建、驱动和日志。用单任务、单设备的小规模作业隔离问题。对接批量不足可调小批次。GROMACS 并行和卸载选项按所用构建与版本核查。 [GROMACS performance](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/user-guide/mdrun-performance.html) · [Uni-Dock](https://github.com/dptech-corp/Uni-Dock) - **checkpoint 追加失败** 检查运行前缀、TPR/CPT 对应关系，以及原始输出是否仍完整。修复配套文件或按官方流程分段续跑并归档实际分段。 [Managing long simulations](https://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/user-guide/managing-simulations.html) - **生产状态不清楚** 将输入准备、生产运行和完成验收分开记录。`md.tpr` 可读时可核对编译参数，正式运行的起止步数以日志、checkpoint 和实际轨迹为据。 [生产交接](SIMULATION.zh-CN.md#server-handoff) [返回排错目录](#troubleshooting-contents) ## 网课常见误操作与流程对照 下例用常见教学操作复现问题，供跟练时自查。 ### 网课错误流程图 按箭头阅读常见误操作。下表说明各项后果及纠正方法。对接分数与 RMSD 的判读见[主教程的分析章节](ANALYSIS.zh-CN.md#analysis)。

blocks.en: | Common shortcut | Consequence | Fix | | --- | --- | --- | | Delete everything outside the protein | This can remove the co-crystal reference ligand, a coordination metal, or an essential cofactor. | Save the reference ligand first and document each component decision. Model essential metals and cofactors explicitly. | | Copy 60 ADT intervals into Vina as `size_x = 60` | At 0.375 Å per interval, the intended length is 22.5 Å. Entering 60 greatly enlarges the search space. | Convert to Å and inspect coverage on the receptor and reference ligand. | | Regenerate 3D geometry while converting a docked PDBQT to MOL2 | The reconstructed graph can be wrong and the ligand may move or change pose. | Recover the SDF graph with Meeko, then convert the format while retaining the pose coordinates. | | Treat a working CUDA driver as GPU support in upstream `vina.exe` | Standard upstream Vina batch docking still runs on the CPU. | Choose Uni-Dock CUDA or an engine with a documented GPU backend and check both its log and device activity. | | Include a GAFF2 ligand directly in a CHARMM36m topology | Nonbonded defaults, 1–4 rules, and parameter conventions can conflict. | Use the matched AMBER + GAFF2 or CHARMM + CGenFF combination. | | Raise `-maxwarn` after warnings or interpret the lowest docking score as affinity | This can hide topology and parameter problems or overstate a screening result. | Review the expanded topology, warning messages, and redocking, and use independent experiments to assess affinity. | ![Figure 2. The risk is the unverified transfer of chemical identity and atom order.](../assets/legacy-comparison.png) *Figure 2. The risk is the unverified transfer of chemical identity and atom order.* ### Tutorial shortcut and reviewed workflow Optimize the ligand in Chem3D, export `ligand.mol2`, and use AutoDockTools (ADT) to prepare `ligand.pdbqt`. After Vina writes `output.pdbqt`, the shortcut saves the selected pose as MOL2 in PyMOL and passes it to ACPYPE or a similar tool to generate `lig.top` or `lig.itp`. The Meeko route recovers the SDF, verifies chemistry and pose coordinates, and then converts to MOL2 for parameterization. Completed ADT jobs can use the [original SDF template](DOCKING.md#legacy-adt-handoff).

blocks.en:
**The risk arises during docking-to-MD transfer.** Chem3D can generate conformers, and a chemically verified MOL2 can serve as input for parameterization. PDBQT records coordinates, atom types, and docking partial charges. Recovery of complete bond orders and formal charge requires the original chemical graph or equivalent mapping metadata. Preparation can merge nonpolar hydrogens. After saving MOL2 in PyMOL, compare bond orders, aromaticity, protonation, and net charge against the source ligand even when the heavy-atom coordinates agree. Successful parameterization still requires independent verification of ligand chemistry. Assign MD partial charges using the selected force-field protocol.<sup>[4](#ref-4),[9](#ref-9)</sup>

**Checked pose transfer.** Archive an SDF or MOL2 with the same microstate as the docking input. Retain `REMARK SMILES` and `REMARK SMILES IDX` during Meeko preparation. Recover the selected docking pose and verify bond orders, stereochemistry, net charge, and heavy-atom coordinates. If MOL2 is required, convert without altering the coordinates and use the selected AMBER or CHARMM parameterization route. For legacy ADT output, establish an unambiguous atom map to the original ligand. Redock a Meeko-prepared input if the mapping cannot be verified.<sup>[4](#ref-4)</sup>


References · [Vina: Exporting results to SDF](https://autodock-vina.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docking_basic.html#exporting-results-to-sdf) · [Meeko: Exporting docking results](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/export_usage.html) · [PyMOL: Save](https://pymolwiki.org/index.php/Save) · [ACPYPE: Ligand parameterization](https://acpype.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)

Run the following commands from the step 05 work directory to export and convert a Meeko-prepared pose. Set the SDF record number to the value established during pose selection.

**Environment:** `docking-gromacs`. **Expected files or evidence:** `docked_poses.sdf`. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
**风险出在对接到 MD 的交接。** Chem3D 可以用于构象准备，经过化学核验的 MOL2 可以用于参数化。PDBQT 保存对接坐标、原子类型和 partial charge（部分电荷）。恢复完整 bond order（键级）和 formal charge（形式电荷）需要原始化学图或等效的映射信息。制备时也可能合并非极性氢。PyMOL 另存为 MOL2 后，即使 heavy atom（重原子）坐标一致，也需要对照原始配体检查 bond order（键级）、芳香性、protonation state（质子化状态）和净电荷。参数化工具成功处理输入后仍需完成化学核验。MD 的 partial charge（部分电荷）应按所选 force field（力场）方案生成。<sup>[4](#ref-4),[9](#ref-9)</sup>

**可靠的交接方法。** 保存与对接输入相同微观状态的 SDF 或 MOL2。用 Meeko 制备时保留 `REMARK SMILES` 和 `REMARK SMILES IDX`。恢复选定的 docking pose（对接位姿）后，核对 bond order（键级）、stereochemistry（立体化学）、净电荷及 heavy atom（重原子）坐标。如需 MOL2，在保持坐标的前提下转换，再按所选 AMBER 或 CHARMM 路线参数化。旧 ADT 输出应建立到原始配体的明确 atom mapping（原子映射）。无法核验时，用 Meeko 重新制备并对接。<sup>[4](#ref-4)</sup>


依据 · [Vina: Exporting results to SDF](https://autodock-vina.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docking_basic.html#exporting-results-to-sdf) · [Meeko: Exporting docking results](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/export_usage.html) · [PyMOL: Save](https://pymolwiki.org/index.php/Save) · [ACPYPE: Ligand parameterization](https://acpype.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)

例如，一个来自 Meeko 对接任务的 PDBQT 应先恢复为 SDF，再取经核对的记录转 MOL2。以下在步骤 05 的目录运行，`1` 是核对过的记录号示例。

**环境：** `docking-gromacs`。**预期文件或核查依据：** `docked_poses.sdf`。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.en:
Check that the selection matches the ligand. Inspect the atomic-number field in the ligand `[ atomtypes ]` section and the corresponding TPR. Some ACPYPE versions omit that optional column. The fixture script now validates the ACPYPE atom order and assigned elements, adds atomic numbers by atom type in a new ITP, and preserves the other parameters. Rebuild the TPR from the reviewed topology and the matching atom ordering before rerunning hydrogen-bond analysis. A ligand with genuinely absent donors or acceptors still needs chemistry-aware interpretation. [GROMACS topology format](https://manual.gromacs.org/2026.3/reference-manual/topologies/topology-file-formats.html) · [Hydrogen-bond method](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jcim.3c02087)

**Environment:** `docking-gromacs`. Run from the completed smoke directory. The output is a separate XVG containing ps versus bond count. The 1IEP smoke has 11 frames and completes this analysis within seconds.

**Environment:** `docking-gromacs`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
先核对分组是否对应配体，再检查配体 `[ atomtypes ]` 和对应 TPR 中的原子序数。部分 ACPYPE 版本省略这列可选字段。公开示例的脚本核对 ACPYPE 原子顺序和元素后，在新 ITP 中按原子类型补写原子序数，其余参数原样保留。从已核查 topology（拓扑）和顺序匹配的坐标重建 TPR，再运行氢键分析。如果配体本身确实缺乏供体或受体，仍须结合其化学结构解释。[GROMACS topology 文件格式](https://manual.gromacs.org/2026.3/reference-manual/topologies/topology-file-formats.html) · [氢键方法论文](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jcim.3c02087)

**环境：** `docking-gromacs`。从已完成的短测试目录运行。输出独立 XVG，记录时间（ps）与计数。此示例有 11 帧，分析数秒内完成。

**环境：** `docking-gromacs`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```bash
gmx hbond -s md/md.tpr -f analysis/centered.xtc -n md/analysis_full.ndx -r 'group "Protein"' -t 'group "Ligand"' -num analysis/hbond.xvg
```

blocks.en: Option names are documented in [GROMACS 2026.3 hbond](https://manual.gromacs.org/2026.3/onlinehelp/gmx-hbond.html). The [measured series](../examples/expected/hbond.csv) contains counts of 3–5 per frame. Review donor chemistry and geometry before assigning individual hydrogen bonds. ## Deliberate atom-order failure Swapping the coordinate triples of the first two MOL2 atoms in a scratch copy, while preserving the ACPYPE topology and names, triggered the following stage 07 failure.
blocks.zh: 参数见 [GROMACS 2026.3 hbond](https://manual.gromacs.org/2026.3/onlinehelp/gmx-hbond.html)。[实测序列](../examples/expected/hbond.csv)每帧为 3–5 条。仅在检查具体供受体化学性质与几何后做氢键归属。 ## 故意错配原子的实验 在临时副本中交换 MOL2 最前两个原子的三维坐标，并保留 ACPYPE topology（拓扑）和原子名，阶段 07 实际报出以下错误。

blocks.shared:
```text
ValueError: ACPYPE coordinate or atom-order mismatch at atom 1.
```

blocks.en: Recreate the matched ligand GRO and ITP from the same verified MOL2 and preserve the mapping. Stop at this check even when atom counts and names appear to match.
blocks.zh: 用同一份经核验的 MOL2 重新取得匹配的配体 GRO 与 ITP，并保存映射。即使原子数和名称表面一致，该错误仍须先解决。
